about: Fixtures whose warning or notice on the last version before the change is accepted as an early sign of that change (see tools/build-messages.php). Reviewed by hand: the warning has to come from the very thing that later fails, not from something the fixture happened to do. Patterns are matched against the fixture file name.

rejected.call.openssl_seal_without_method: the 7.4 warning is about the key, which the fixture does not have; it says nothing about the missing argument
rejected.call.exit_argument_type: the notice about an array turned into a string is raised by many other things
rejected.call.invalid_literal_argument (imagepng): a libpng message, not a check of PHP itself
rejected.runtime.mb_http_output_null_byte, runtim: the warning about an unknown encoding is raised for any wrong encoding name, with or without a null byte
the warning comes from the missing server or file of the fixture
rejected.runtime.array_key_exists_key_type, runti: the later behaviour is a different result, not an error; not reviewed closely enough to state it to a site owner
